title: Reading a Travel Brochure
text:
A travel brochure is a small booklet that gives information about a place. It has colourful photos, short descriptions and a map. Many brochures are free at hotels, shops and tourist offices.

Good brochures are clear and easy to read. They often show prices, opening times and contact details. Before you choose a trip, read the brochure carefully and check the information.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, where can you get free brochures?
options: At hotels, shops and tourist offices

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what information do brochures often show?
options: Prices, opening times and contact details

questions.text: Why should you read a brochure carefully before you choose a trip?
options: Because the information may be important for your decision
Because you must buy the brochure
Because the map is too small to see

questions.text: What can you infer about the photos in a brochure?
options: They are meant to attract the reader's attention
They are always taken by the reader
They are usually black and white
They are not connected to the place

vocabulary.definition: a small thin book with information
a person who visits a place for pleasure
in a way that pays close attention

paragraph_translations: Um folheto de viagem é um pequeno livreto que dá informações sobre um lugar. Ele tem fotos coloridas, descrições curtas e um mapa. Muitos folhetos são gratuitos em hotéis, lojas e postos de turismo.

Bons folhetos são claros e fáceis de ler. Eles costumam mostrar preços, horários de funcionamento e dados de contato. Antes de escolher uma viagem, leia o folheto com atenção e confira as informações.
